reels.thought: Not tolerating you. Not putting up with you. Rejoicing over you, out loud, with singing.
reels.verse: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
reels.think: When did you last let yourself be delighted in?

reels.hook: The hand is already reaching for you.
reels.thought: You don't have to climb out alone. He's not waiting at the top. He came down to where you are.
reels.verse: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
reels.think: What would you put down if you knew someone was holding you up?

reels.hook: Look up. Someone painted this for you.
reels.thought: Every sunrise is a signature. The same hands that stretched out the sky formed you.
reels.verse: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
reels.think: What did you see today that only God could make?

reels.hook: Yesterday is not the boss of today.
reels.thought: Mercy didn't run out overnight. It refilled while you slept.
reels.verse: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
reels.think: What do you need a fresh start on this morning?

reels.thought: Eagles don't flap harder. They wait for the wind, then rise. Walking without fainting is a victory too.
reels.verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
reels.think: Where are you trying to fly when God is asking you to walk?

reels.hook: You were never meant to carry it alone.
reels.thought: Strength isn't hiding the fall. Strength is letting someone help you up.
reels.verse: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
reels.think: Who could you text today just to say, I'm here?

reels.hook: Worry is a prayer pointed the wrong way.
reels.thought: Turn the same energy toward heaven, and add thank you. Peace follows that you can't explain.
reels.verse: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
reels.think: What worry can you hand over right now, by name?

reels.hook: Broken is not the end of the story.
reels.thought: He doesn't keep his distance from heartbreak. He draws closest there.
reels.verse: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
reels.think: Where do you need God close today?

reels.thought: Even the One who made the world rested. Weary is an invitation, not a failure.
reels.verse: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
reels.think: What would real rest look like for you this week?

reels.hook: You don't need the whole map.
reels.thought: Just the next step. Trust lights the path one footprint at a time.
reels.verse: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
reels.think: What's one next step you already know to take?

reels.thought: Fearfully. Wonderfully. Made on purpose, by Someone who doesn't make mistakes.
reels.verse: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
reels.think: What's something about how God made you that you've been hiding?

reels.hook: Courage is fear that kept walking.
reels.thought: Being afraid doesn't disqualify you. Going anyway, with Him beside you, is the whole point.
reels.verse: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
reels.think: What would you do this week if fear got a smaller vote?

reels.thought: Borrowing tomorrow's trouble never paid off a single bill. Live this one well.
reels.verse: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
reels.think: What's one thing you can stop rehearsing that hasn't happened yet?

reels.thought: Stillness is where the noise stops and you remember who is God, and who isn't.
reels.verse: Be still, and know that I am God.
reels.think: Can you give God sixty quiet seconds right now?

reels.hook: Nothing is wasted in His hands.
reels.thought: Not the detour. Not the delay. Not the tears. He is weaving it together.
reels.verse: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
reels.think: What hard season is God still weaving into good?

reels.thought: Seeds look like nothing for a long time. Then everything at once.
reels.verse: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
reels.think: What have you planted that you're tempted to dig up?

reels.thought: Laughter isn't shallow. It's one of the ways God heals what's been dried out.
reels.verse: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
reels.think: Who makes you laugh, and when did you last call them?

reels.thought: Tears are allowed. Morning is promised.
reels.verse: Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
reels.think: What morning are you holding on for?

reels.hook: Through. Not around. Through, with Him.
reels.thought: You may not skip the water or the fire, but you won't go under and you won't burn up.
reels.verse: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
reels.think: What are you walking through that He's walking through with you?

reels.hook: Let Him lead you somewhere green.
reels.thought: A good shepherd doesn't drive the sheep. He leads them to rest and water and restores what ran dry.
reels.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. He restoreth my soul.
reels.think: Where is your soul running dry?

reels.thought: The dishes, the shift, the homework, the hard conversation. Do it like He's the one watching.
reels.verse: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
reels.think: What ordinary task could become an offering today?

reels.hook: Plans go farther when you hand them over.
reels.thought: Write the vision, then give Him the pen.
reels.verse: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
reels.think: What plan have you not prayed over yet?

reels.thought: Water, sleep, a walk, a meal that loves you back. Caring for the temple is spiritual.
reels.verse: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
reels.think: What's one kind thing you can do for your body today?

reels.thought: You don't have to be loud to shine. You just can't hide it.
reels.verse: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
reels.think: Who might be in the dark and need you to show up?

reels.thought: Not to argue. To love. A text, a call, a kind word can change a whole day.
reels.verse: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
reels.think: Whose name came to mind just now?

reels.hook: Change your mind, change your life.
reels.thought: Transformation starts on the inside. Renew the thoughts, and the path follows.
reels.verse: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind,
reels.think: What thought have you been repeating that isn't true?

reels.hook: Strength you didn't know you had.
reels.thought: Not by grinding harder, but by leaning harder on Him.
reels.verse: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
reels.think: What 'all things' are you facing this week?

reels.thought: When your head is down, your help is up. The Maker of mountains is on your side.
reels.verse: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
reels.think: Where have you been looking for help instead?

reels.hook: Wisdom is one honest prayer away.
reels.thought: He doesn't roll His eyes at the question. He gives generously.
reels.verse: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
reels.think: What decision do you need wisdom for?

reels.hook: Guard your heart. Everything flows from it.
reels.thought: What you let in, you eventually live out.
reels.verse: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
reels.think: What's been flowing into your heart lately?

reels.hook: He already went ahead of you.
reels.thought: Wherever today takes you, He's been there first and He's not leaving.
reels.verse: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
reels.think: What's ahead that you can stop dreading?

reels.hook: This day was made on purpose.
reels.thought: Not a leftover. Not a filler. A gift with your name on it.
reels.verse: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
reels.think: What's one thing worth celebrating today?

reels.thought: Gratitude doesn't deny the hard. It just refuses to let the hard have the last word.
reels.verse: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
reels.think: Name four gifts from today, even small ones.

reels.hook: The whole assignment, in one sentence.
reels.thought: Do right. Love mercy. Walk humbly. Everything else is commentary.
reels.verse: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
reels.think: Which of the three is calling you today?

reels.thought: Alone, a thread snaps. Knit together in love, it holds.
reels.verse: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love,
reels.think: Who are the threads woven into your life?

reels.thought: It lives where the mind keeps returning to Him.
reels.verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
reels.think: Where does your mind wander when it's anxious?

reels.thought: Not patched up. Made new. The old has passed.
reels.verse: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
reels.think: What old thing is God ready for you to leave behind?

reels.hook: You are not alone. Keep pushing one more day.
reels.thought: If today feels too heavy, tell someone. Call or text 988 any time. Your life matters here.
reels.verse: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
reels.think: Who is one person you could reach out to tonight?

reels.thought: Not the perfect church attendance or the perfect words. The way we treat each other.
reels.verse: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
reels.think: How can your love be visible to someone today?

reels.thought: Put Him at the top of the list, and watch the rest of the list get rearranged.
reels.verse: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
reels.think: What's been sitting in first place instead?

reels.thought: Anxiety says you have to hold everything together. God says hand it over, because He actually cares how this turns out for you.
reels.verse: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
reels.think: What's one worry you can hand over before you sleep tonight?

reels.hook: Fear is loud. It isn't in charge.
reels.thought: Fear gets a voice, not a vote. The spirit God gave you is stronger than the thing shouting at you.
reels.verse: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
reels.think: What would you do today if fear didn't get a vote?

reels.hook: Peace that doesn't have to make sense.
reels.thought: It won't add up on paper. It will still guard your heart.
reels.verse: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
reels.think: Where do you need peace that doesn't depend on how things look?

reels.hook: When I am afraid, I will trust.
reels.thought: Not if. When. Fear will show up. Trust is what you choose to do next.
reels.verse: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
reels.think: Name the fear out loud. Then say this verse.

reels.hook: Too many thoughts? Let comfort in.
reels.thought: Racing thoughts don't change who holds tomorrow. Slow down and let His comfort reach you.
reels.verse: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
reels.think: Which thought is running you ragged today?

reels.thought: They don't stockpile, plan, or panic, and they're fed anyway. You matter more than they do.
reels.verse: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
reels.think: What need are you afraid God will forget?

reels.thought: It can squeeze you without breaking you. You've survived every hard day so far.
reels.verse: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair; Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
reels.think: Which hard day are you proud you made it through?

reels.hook: His strength shows up in your weak spot.
reels.thought: You don't have to fake strong. The weak place is where His power does its best work.
reels.verse: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
reels.think: Where can you stop pretending to be strong today?

reels.thought: Not a far-off idea. A present help, right in the middle of the trouble.
reels.verse: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
reels.think: Where do you need help that's present, not someday?

reels.thought: Falling isn't failing. Staying down is optional.
reels.verse: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again:
reels.think: What's one small way to get back up today?

reels.thought: Storms move sand. They don't move rock.
reels.verse: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust;
reels.think: What are you standing on right now?

reels.thought: Comparison steals your breath. Keep your eyes on Jesus and keep a steady pace.
reels.verse: Let us run with patience the race that is set before us, Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith;
reels.think: Whose race have you been trying to run?

reels.thought: He knew how the story would end and still cried with them. Your tears are not a lack of faith.
reels.verse: Jesus wept.
reels.think: Who have you not let yourself grieve?

reels.thought: Not only the wound, the heart behind it.
reels.verse: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
reels.think: What wound are you ready to let Him touch?

reels.thought: Grief is love with nowhere to go. God meets you right there.
reels.verse: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
reels.think: Who comforted you once, and who can you comfort now?

reels.thought: Not one was wasted. Not one went unseen.
reels.verse: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
reels.think: What tears have you been hiding from God?

reels.hook: A day with no more tears is coming.
reels.thought: This hurt is real, and it is not forever.
reels.verse: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
reels.think: What hope helps you hold on?

reels.thought: The pain you walked through can become a path for someone else.
reels.verse: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
reels.think: Who's walking through something you've already survived?

reels.thought: You weren't an afterthought or a backup plan. You were picked.
reels.verse: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
reels.think: What changes if you really believe you were chosen?

reels.thought: Before anyone had an opinion of you, God had a plan for you.
reels.verse: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee,
reels.think: What label do you need to stop wearing?

reels.thought: Not mass-produced. Made with good work already waiting for you.
reels.verse: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
reels.think: What good work might be waiting on you this week?

reels.hook: Loved before you got it right.
reels.thought: He didn't wait for you to clean up first.
reels.verse: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
reels.think: Where are you still trying to earn love?

reels.thought: You're not a number in a crowd. He knows your name and calls you His.
reels.verse: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
reels.think: Say your name, then say: I am His.

reels.thought: Not your past, your mistakes, or your worst day.
reels.verse: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
reels.think: What have you believed could separate you from His love?

reels.hook: Come away and rest a while.
reels.thought: Even Jesus pulled His friends away from the crowd. Rest is obedience, not laziness.
reels.verse: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while:
reels.think: When is your quiet place this week?

reels.thought: You can close your eyes. He doesn't close His.
reels.verse: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
reels.think: What would help you lay it down tonight?

reels.hook: He never sleeps, so you can.
reels.thought: The One who keeps you doesn't nap or clock out.
reels.verse: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
reels.think: What are you staying up trying to guard?

reels.thought: David reminded himself how good God had been. You can too.
reels.verse: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
reels.think: List three ways He's been good to you.

reels.hook: Quiet is a kind of strength.
reels.thought: Strength sometimes looks like stillness and trust, not hustle.
reels.verse: In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength:
reels.think: Where could quiet be your strength today?

reels.thought: Stop staring at what was. Something new is already springing up.
reels.verse: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it?
reels.think: What new thing might you miss by looking back?

reels.thought: You can't run forward while looking backward.
reels.verse: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
reels.think: What do you need to stop replaying?

reels.hook: As far as east from west.
reels.thought: Your forgiven sin isn't parked nearby. He moved it out of reach.
reels.verse: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
reels.think: What are you still punishing yourself for?

reels.thought: Conviction calls you home. Condemnation keeps you hiding. In Christ, the verdict is in.
reels.verse: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus,
reels.think: What would you do differently without shame?

reels.thought: You're not a project He'll abandon halfway.
reels.verse: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
reels.think: What has God started in you that you gave up on?

reels.thought: The vision has an appointed time. Delay is not denial.
reels.verse: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
reels.think: What promise are you still waiting on?

reels.thought: Waiting isn't doing nothing. It's choosing courage while the answer is on the way.
reels.verse: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
reels.think: What can you do faithfully while you wait?

reels.thought: Not your timeline. His. And His timing makes things beautiful.
reels.verse: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time:
reels.think: Where are you rushing God?

reels.thought: What feels like delay might be mercy giving someone time.
reels.verse: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward,
reels.think: Who might your waiting season be helping?

reels.thought: You don't dig up seeds to check on them. Plant, water, trust.
reels.verse: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
reels.think: What seed did you plant that needs time, not worry?

reels.thought: God's thoughts toward you are good, with a future and a hope.
reels.verse: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
reels.think: What hope have you stopped expecting?

reels.hook: For such a time as this.
reels.thought: Where you are is not an accident. You might be the answer someone is praying for.
reels.verse: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
reels.think: Who around you needs you to be brave?

reels.thought: Whatever is in your hand today, give it your best.
reels.verse: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might;
reels.think: What's in your hand to do today?

reels.thought: Diligence opens doors that talk can't.
reels.verse: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
reels.think: What skill could you sharpen this month?

reels.thought: Your gift wasn't given to sit on a shelf. Serve with it.
reels.verse: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
reels.think: What gift have you been sitting on?

reels.thought: Don't look down on the start. God doesn't.
reels.verse: For who hath despised the day of small things?
reels.think: What small start can you celebrate?

reels.thought: Need, not every want. And He supplies from riches, not scraps.
reels.verse: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
reels.think: What need will you trust Him with this week?

reels.thought: Faith doesn't skip the math. Wise builders plan before they build.
reels.verse: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
reels.think: What do you need to sit down and count?

reels.thought: Fast money fades. Steady money grows.
reels.verse: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
reels.think: What small amount could you set aside this week?

reels.thought: Giving doesn't drain you the way you think. It waters you too.
reels.verse: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
reels.think: Who could you bless with something small today?

reels.thought: Peace doesn't come from more. It comes from knowing He won't leave.
reels.verse: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
reels.think: What do you already have that is enough?

reels.thought: Borrowing makes you serve someone else. Freedom is worth the sacrifice.
reels.verse: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
reels.think: What's one step toward less debt?

reels.thought: Real love isn't a feeling that comes and goes. It's a choice you make on the hard days.
reels.verse: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
reels.think: Where can you be more patient with someone you love?

reels.thought: Two is strong. Two with God in the middle is hard to break.
reels.verse: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
reels.think: How do you keep God in the middle of your closest relationship?

reels.hook: Don't let the sun go down on it.
reels.thought: Anger can be honest. Holding it overnight gives it a home.
reels.verse: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
reels.think: Is there something to make right before tonight?

reels.thought: Not ignoring wrong. Choosing not to keep score.
reels.verse: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
reels.think: What score could you stop keeping?

reels.thought: The tone you choose decides where the conversation goes.
reels.verse: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
reels.think: How can you say the hard thing softly today?

reels.thought: Everything else fades. Love outlasts it.
reels.verse: Charity never faileth:
reels.think: Who needs to hear you love them today?

reels.thought: What you plant now grows with them for the rest of their lives.
reels.verse: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
reels.think: What do you want your children to remember about your faith?

reels.thought: Not an interruption. A reward.
reels.verse: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
reels.think: What do you love about a child in your life?

reels.thought: Correction works best when love is louder than frustration.
reels.verse: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
reels.think: How can you correct with more love this week?

reels.hook: As for me and my house.
reels.thought: Someone in your family has to decide first. Let it be you.
reels.verse: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
reels.think: What one habit could your house start together?

reels.thought: Honor isn't pretending everything was perfect. It's choosing respect and grace.
reels.verse: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
reels.think: How can you honor a parent or elder this week?

reels.thought: Faith gets passed down at the table, in the car, and at bedtime.
reels.verse: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
reels.think: Where can you talk about God with your family today?

reels.thought: Good friends don't just agree with you. They make you better.
reels.verse: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
reels.think: Who sharpens you?

reels.thought: Somebody's load is too heavy today. You might be the help.
reels.verse: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
reels.think: Whose burden could you help carry?

reels.thought: Some friends are seasonal. Some are family you choose.
reels.verse: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
reels.think: Who's a friend you need to call?

reels.thought: You don't need a crowd for God to show up.
reels.verse: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
reels.think: Who could you pray with this week?

reels.thought: Celebrate the wins. Sit with the losses.
reels.verse: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
reels.think: Whose good news can you celebrate today?

reels.thought: Temptation is not a trap without an exit. God builds the door.
reels.verse: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
reels.think: What's your way out the next time it shows up?

reels.thought: Not almost free. Not free on good days. Free.
reels.verse: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
reels.think: What chain do you want to break?

reels.thought: You have more authority than the pull you feel.
reels.verse: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
reels.think: What does resisting look like for you this week?

reels.thought: Hiding keeps it alive. Light breaks its grip.
reels.verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
reels.think: What do you need to bring into the light?

reels.hook: Don't walk back into the cage.
reels.thought: You got free. Stay free.
reels.verse: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
reels.think: What old habit keeps calling you back?

reels.hook: Some fights you win by leaving.
reels.thought: Running from temptation isn't weakness. It's wisdom.
reels.verse: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
reels.think: What do you need to walk away from?

reels.thought: Forgiveness doesn't excuse what happened. It frees you from carrying it.
reels.verse: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
reels.think: Who do you need to release?

reels.thought: Forgiveness isn't always one moment. Sometimes it's a daily decision.
reels.verse: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
reels.think: What hurt keeps coming back up?

reels.hook: You don't have to get even.
reels.thought: Justice is in better hands than yours.
reels.verse: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
reels.think: What are you trying to settle that belongs to God?

reels.thought: It's hard to stay bitter at someone you pray for.
reels.verse: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
reels.think: Can you pray one sentence for someone who hurt you?

reels.thought: If God isn't holding it against you, you can put it down.
reels.verse: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
reels.think: What are you still holding against yourself?

reels.thought: Smart isn't the same as wise. Wisdom begins with knowing who God is.
reels.verse: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
reels.think: Where do you need wisdom, not just information?

reels.thought: Lonely decisions are risky decisions. Ask wise people.
reels.verse: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
reels.think: Who could you ask before you decide?

reels.thought: Who you walk with shapes where you end up.
reels.verse: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
reels.think: Who is shaping your direction lately?

reels.thought: Most arguments end better when listening goes first.
reels.verse: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
reels.think: Who do you need to really listen to?

reels.hook: A lamp for the next step.
reels.thought: The Word doesn't light the whole road. It lights where you're standing.
reels.verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
reels.think: What does today's step look like?

reels.thought: What you dwell on, you become.
reels.verse: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
reels.think: What thought do you need to replace today?

reels.thought: Joy isn't the absence of trouble. It's fuel for getting through it.
reels.verse: for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
reels.think: What brings you joy that has nothing to do with money?

reels.thought: Gratitude remembers what worry forgets.
reels.verse: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
reels.think: Name five good things from this week.

reels.thought: Paul wrote this from a prison cell. Joy isn't about where you are.
reels.verse: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
reels.think: What can you rejoice about from right where you are?

reels.thought: Every good thing in your life came from somewhere. Say thank You.
reels.verse: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights,
reels.think: What good gift do you take for granted?

reels.thought: Praise doesn't have to be pretty. It has to be yours.
reels.verse: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
reels.think: What song lifts you up? Play it today.

reels.thought: God isn't annoyed by your asking. He invites it.
reels.verse: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
reels.think: What have you stopped asking for?

reels.thought: Prayer isn't only on your knees. It's a conversation that runs all day.
reels.verse: Pray without ceasing.
reels.think: Where can you whisper a prayer today?

reels.thought: He'll show you things you didn't even know to ask about.
reels.verse: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
reels.think: What do you want to ask Him right now?

reels.thought: When you can't find the words, the Spirit prays for you.
reels.verse: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
reels.think: Sit quietly for one minute and just be with God.

reels.thought: Your secret prayers aren't secret to Him.
reels.verse: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
reels.think: Where is your prayer closet?

reels.thought: Healing often travels through someone else's prayer.
reels.verse: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
reels.think: Who will you pray for by name today?

reels.thought: Your age doesn't cancel your example.
reels.verse: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
reels.think: How can you lead by example this week?

reels.thought: Don't wait until life gets hard to know God.
reels.verse: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth,
reels.think: What does following God look like at your age?

reels.thought: Pressure is real. The Word gives you a way through it.
reels.verse: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
reels.think: What helps you make good choices under pressure?

reels.thought: David was young when he faced Goliath. He remembered what God had already done.
reels.verse: The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.
reels.think: What giant are you facing?

reels.thought: Jesus grew in wisdom, body, and friendships. Growing is holy.
reels.verse: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
reels.think: Which area do you want to grow in this year?

reels.thought: God cares about your body and your soul together.
reels.verse: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
reels.think: What's one healthy choice for today?

reels.hook: He is the God who heals.
reels.thought: Keep praying, and keep following wise care.
reels.verse: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
reels.think: Where do you need healing?

reels.thought: Training your body teaches your spirit to keep its word too.
reels.verse: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection:
reels.think: What one discipline would help you most?

reels.thought: A kind word can lift what weighs you down.
reels.verse: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
reels.think: Who needs a good word from you today?

reels.thought: Bodies age. The inside can keep getting stronger.
reels.verse: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
reels.think: How are you renewing your inner self?

reels.thought: Not because they earned it. Because you know what it's like to be let off the hook by love.
reels.verse: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
reels.think: Who is the quarrel you keep carrying into prayer?

reels.thought: Bitterness doesn't hurt them nearly as much as it clogs up your own prayers. Let it go, and let heaven through.
reels.verse: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
reels.think: What name comes up every time you try to pray?

reels.hook: Your sins are at the bottom of the sea.
reels.thought: God doesn't fish them back up to remind you. You shouldn't either.
reels.verse: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
reels.think: What old failure do you keep dragging back to the surface?

reels.hook: He forgave while it still hurt.
reels.thought: Jesus didn't wait until the pain stopped. He prayed for them from the cross. Forgiveness can start before the feelings do.
reels.verse: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do.
reels.think: Can you pray one honest sentence for someone who hurt you?

reels.thought: Faith isn't just for later. What you build with God now will hold you up for the rest of your life.
reels.verse: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
reels.think: What do you want your faith to look like in ten years?

reels.hook: Your strength is a gift. Spend it well.
reels.thought: Young energy isn't meant to be wasted. Point it at something that matters.
reels.verse: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
reels.think: What would you build if you knew your energy was a gift from God?

reels.thought: God doesn't wait for you to be older to use you. If He sends you, He'll give you the words.
reels.verse: But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
reels.think: Where have you been telling yourself you're not old enough yet?

reels.hook: Strong is having the Word inside you.
reels.thought: Real strength isn't the loudest voice in the room. It's what you're filled with when nobody is watching.
reels.verse: I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
reels.think: What verse could you carry in your pocket this week?

reels.hook: Walking with God is good for your bones.
reels.thought: Humility and wise choices aren't just spiritual. They show up in your body, your sleep, and your stress.
reels.verse: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil. It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
reels.think: What habit is costing your body more than it gives?

reels.thought: Healing can be slow, and it can come through doctors, rest, and time. He's still the one doing it.
reels.verse: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD;
reels.think: What part of you needs healing that you haven't asked for yet?

reels.hook: Sleep is a gift, not a reward.
reels.thought: Staying up worrying doesn't fix tomorrow. He gives His beloved sleep. You're allowed to close your eyes.
reels.verse: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
reels.think: What would change if you went to bed an hour earlier this week?

reels.thought: The model for love in a marriage is not fifty-fifty. It's Christ, giving all of Himself first.
reels.verse: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
reels.think: What's one way you could give first today, without keeping score?

reels.thought: Floods come in every relationship. Love rooted in God keeps its head above water.
reels.verse: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it:
reels.think: What storm has your love already survived?

reels.thought: Not naive. Not blind. Just stubborn about hope.
reels.verse: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
reels.think: Who do you need to believe the best about today?

reels.hook: Nobody was made to be alone.
reels.thought: God puts the lonely into families. Sometimes that family is blood, and sometimes it's the people He sends.
reels.verse: God setteth the solitary in families:
reels.think: Who has God placed around you as family?

reels.hook: Your children are in good hands.
reels.thought: You can't teach them everything. He will teach them what you can't, and give them peace you couldn't buy.
reels.verse: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
reels.think: Which child can you place in God's hands by name right now?

reels.thought: Ruth didn't leave when it got hard. Family is built by the ones who choose to stay.
reels.verse: Whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
reels.think: Who has stayed with you, and have you told them thank you?

reels.hook: Talk to Him before you talk to anyone else.
reels.thought: Give God the first words of your morning, then look up and watch for His answer.
reels.verse: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
reels.think: What could your first prayer tomorrow morning be?

reels.thought: When the answer is slow, the temptation is to quit asking. Jesus said keep going.
reels.verse: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
reels.think: What prayer have you almost stopped praying?

reels.hook: He is close when you call.
reels.thought: You don't need fancy words. You need honest ones. He's near to anyone who calls in truth.
reels.verse: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
reels.think: What's the most honest thing you could tell God right now?

reels.thought: You don't have to clean yourself up first. Ask Him to do the creating.
reels.verse: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
reels.think: What do you want God to make new in you today?

reels.hook: He can give back the lost years.
reels.thought: The time you think you wasted isn't beyond His reach. He specializes in restoration.
reels.verse: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten,
reels.think: What season do you need God to redeem?

reels.hook: Waiting on Him is never wasted.
reels.thought: He is good to the ones who wait and keep seeking. The waiting room is still in His house.
reels.verse: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
reels.think: How can you seek Him while you wait?

reels.thought: Patient waiting isn't silent waiting. Keep crying out. He bends close to hear.
reels.verse: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
reels.think: What cry have you been holding back?

reels.hook: Give Him the first, not the leftovers.
reels.thought: Honoring God with your money is trust in action. He keeps track of the ones who put Him first.
reels.verse: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
reels.think: What does putting God first look like in your budget this month?

reels.hook: He has never forgotten His people.
reels.thought: Ask the elders. Lean seasons came and went, and God still made a way.
reels.verse: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
reels.think: When did God provide in a way you can't explain?

reels.thought: Grief is not the end of the story. He trades heaviness for praise, a little at a time.
reels.verse: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness;
reels.think: What would one small step toward praise look like in your grief?

reels.hook: We grieve, but not without hope.
reels.thought: Tears are allowed. Hope is too. For those in Christ, goodbye is not forever.
reels.verse: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
reels.think: Who are you missing today? Say their name to God.

reels.hook: Your name is written on His hands.
reels.thought: You are not forgotten. You are engraved where He can see you every moment.
reels.verse: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands;
reels.think: What would change if you believed God never loses sight of you?

reels.thought: Not a servant trying to earn a place. A child who already has one.
reels.verse: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God:
reels.think: How would a loved child of God carry themselves today?

reels.hook: Out of the pit, onto the rock.
reels.thought: He doesn't just pull you out. He sets your feet somewhere solid and steadies your steps.
reels.verse: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
reels.think: What pit has God already brought you out of?

reels.hook: Where He is, chains don't hold.
reels.thought: Freedom isn't just a feeling. It's what happens wherever His Spirit is welcomed.
reels.verse: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
reels.think: What chain do you want His Spirit to break this week?

reels.thought: You don't have to find peace somewhere else. His presence brings it with Him.
reels.verse: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
reels.think: Where do you need to feel His presence today?

reels.thought: Under His shadow is the safest place to rest. You can go there with one quiet breath.
reels.verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
reels.think: Where is your quiet place to meet with God?

reels.thought: Good advice is helpful. God's Word is where wisdom starts.
reels.verse: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
reels.think: What question do you need to take to Scripture first?

reels.hook: He'll guide you with His eye.
reels.thought: You're not making this choice alone. He promised to teach you the way and watch over you as you go.
reels.verse: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
reels.think: What decision are you ready to let Him guide?

reels.thought: Moods change. Bank accounts change. His goodness stays the same.
reels.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
reels.think: What mercy are you thankful for today?

reels.thought: Fullness of joy is found in His presence. Not after the problem is fixed. In Him.
reels.verse: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
reels.think: When did you last feel real joy in His presence?

reels.hook: The greatest love gives itself away.
reels.thought: Friendship at its best looks like Jesus: showing up, laying down, and staying.
reels.verse: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
reels.think: What could you give up today for a friend?

reels.hook: Real friends show up in the hard times.
reels.thought: Anyone can be around for the fun. A true friend was made for the hard days.
reels.verse: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
reels.think: Which friend is going through something right now?

reels.thought: Make plans. Dream big. Just hold them open, because His counsel is the one that stands.
reels.verse: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
reels.think: Which plan do you need to hold more loosely?

reels.thought: Even the desire to do good is His work in you. Lean into it.
reels.verse: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
reels.think: What good thing has God been stirring you to do?

reels.thought: Fear asks a lot of questions. This verse answers them all with one name.
reels.verse: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
reels.think: What fear can you name and hand to Him?

reels.thought: When you have nothing left, that's exactly who He gives strength to. You are not too tired for Him.
reels.verse: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
reels.think: Where do you feel like you have no might left?

reels.thought: Sometimes you have to preach to yourself. Hope in God. You will praise again. If today is too heavy, call or text 988. You are not alone.
reels.verse: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
reels.think: What do you need to remind your soul of tonight?

reels.hook: Jehovah: the name above every name.
reels.thought: JEHOVAH is God's own covenant name, the One who was, and is, and always will be. He first made it known to Moses in Exodus 6:3, and Psalm 83 says it belongs to Him alone.
reels.verse: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
reels.think: What does it mean to you that God told us His own name?

reels.hook: Jehovah-Elohim: the Lord God, our Creator.
reels.thought: The first time these two names appear together is at creation, in Genesis 2. The covenant God and the mighty Creator are the same One, and He made you too.
reels.verse: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
reels.think: What in creation reminds you most that God is real?

reels.thought: Abraham named the mountain this in Genesis 22, after God provided the ram in the thicket. He sees the need before you get there, and He makes a way.
reels.verse: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
reels.think: Where do you need to trust Jehovah-Jireh to provide right now?

reels.thought: God gave Himself this name in Exodus 15, right after He made the bitter waters of Marah sweet. He heals bodies, hearts, minds and homes.
reels.verse: If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
reels.think: What do you need Jehovah-Rapha to heal today?

reels.hook: Jehovah-Nissi: the Lord is my banner.
reels.thought: Moses built an altar with this name in Exodus 17, after Israel won the battle while his hands were held up. The battle is the Lord's, and you fight under His flag.
reels.verse: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:
reels.think: What battle do you need to put under God's banner?

reels.hook: Jehovah-Mekoddishkem: the Lord who sanctifies you.
reels.thought: In Leviticus 20 and Exodus 31, God says He is the One who sets you apart and makes you holy. You don't clean yourself up first. He does the work.
reels.verse: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.
reels.think: What is God setting you apart for in this season?

reels.thought: Gideon was hiding and afraid in Judges 6 when God spoke peace over him. He built an altar and named it this. Peace is not a feeling. It is a Person.
reels.verse: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
reels.think: Where do you need Jehovah-Shalom to speak peace over you?

reels.hook: Jehovah-Raah: the Lord is my shepherd.
reels.thought: David, a shepherd himself, called God his Shepherd in Psalm 23. He leads, feeds, protects and goes after the one that wandered off.
reels.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
reels.think: Where do you need the Shepherd to lead you this week?

reels.thought: Jeremiah 23 promises a King whose name is The Lord Our Righteousness. Our right standing with God is not earned. It is given through Christ.
reels.verse: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
reels.think: What would change if you stopped trying to earn God's love?

reels.thought: The last verse of Ezekiel names the city of God this. Wherever God's people are, He is there. You are never in a place He has left.
reels.verse: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.
reels.think: Where do you need to remember that the Lord is there?

reels.thought: This name means the Lord of heaven's armies. It first appears in 1 Samuel 1, when Hannah prayed for a child. When you feel outnumbered, the armies of heaven are on your side.
reels.verse: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
reels.think: What feels bigger than you that the Lord of hosts is bigger than?

reels.thought: Psalm 7 praises Him as the Most High. Nothing outranks Him. No diagnosis, no court, no enemy, no bill has the final word.
reels.verse: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
reels.think: What have you let sit higher than God in your thinking?

reels.thought: Psalm 95 calls us to kneel before the Lord our Maker. The One who made you knows exactly how you work, and what you need.
reels.verse: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
reels.think: What part of how God made you can you thank Him for today?

reels.thought: Psalm 99 calls Him our God, not just a god. He belongs to His people, and His people belong to Him. Worship Him, for He is holy.
reels.verse: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
reels.think: What does it mean to you to call Him our God?

reels.thought: God spoke this at the start of the Ten Commandments in Exodus 20. Before He gave one rule, He reminded them who freed them. He is personal. He is yours.
reels.verse: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
reels.think: What has the Lord thy God brought you out of?

reels.thought: David sang this in Psalm 28. When your strength runs out, His doesn't. He is your strength and your shield at the same time.
reels.verse: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
reels.think: Where are you running on empty and need His strength?

reels.thought: In Psalm 18, David was running for his life when God rescued him. He called God his rock, his fortress and his deliverer. He still delivers.
reels.verse: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
reels.think: What do you need Jehovah-Mephalti to deliver you from?

reels.hook: Jehovah-Gmolah: the Lord God of recompense.
reels.thought: Jeremiah 51 says the Lord repays. You don't have to get even. God sees every wrong done to you, and He settles accounts in His time.
reels.verse: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.
reels.think: What wrong can you hand over to God instead of carrying it?

reels.thought: In Ezekiel 7, God names Himself the Lord that smiteth. His correction is not hate. It is a Father refusing to let His children destroy themselves.
reels.verse: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth.
reels.think: Where might God be lovingly correcting you right now?

reels.hook: Soft words turn the heat down.
reels.thought: When someone comes at you hot, a gentle answer cools the room. A harsh word pours gas on the fire. You get to choose which one you hand them.
reels.verse: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
reels.think: Who do you need to answer softly this week?

reels.hook: Let your words build, not break.
reels.thought: Before it leaves your mouth, ask one question: will this build them up, or tear them down? Words should hand people grace, not wounds.
reels.verse: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
reels.think: Before you speak today, will you ask yourself if it builds?

reels.thought: Every word you speak plants something, life or death, in the people around you and in yourself. And you will eat what you plant.
reels.verse: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
reels.think: What have your words been planting at home lately?

reels.thought: A pleasant word is sweet like honey. It can calm a heart, lift a tired body and heal what a hard day broke.
reels.verse: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
reels.think: Who needs a sweet word from you today?

reels.thought: Most arguments go wrong because both people are waiting to talk. Slow down. Hear the whole thing. Anger cools when people feel heard.
reels.verse: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
reels.think: Who do you need to really listen to before you answer?

reels.thought: Salt makes food better, and grace makes words land. You can say the hard thing and still say it with grace.
reels.verse: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
reels.think: What hard thing can you say with more grace?

reels.hook: One mouth, two kinds of water?
reels.thought: We praise God on Sunday and cut people down on Monday. The same mouth that blesses should not curse. God can change both.
reels.verse: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
reels.think: Where does your mouth need to match your praise?

reels.thought: It is easy to be sweet to strangers and sharp with family. Tenderhearted starts with the people who see you every day.
reels.verse: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
reels.think: Who at home needs your kindest words this week?

reels.hook: Some words cut like a sword.
reels.thought: Careless words can stab, even when you were only joking. Wise words do the opposite. They heal.
reels.verse: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
reels.think: Is there a word you said that you need to make right?

reels.hook: Ask God to guard your mouth.
reels.thought: You don't have to do this alone. Ask the Lord to stand at the door of your lips and stop what shouldn't come out.
reels.verse: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
reels.think: Will you pray this verse before your next hard conversation?

reels.thought: Kind does not mean fake. God wants the truth told, but carried in love, so it helps the person grow instead of crushing them.
reels.verse: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
reels.think: What truth do you need to speak, in love?

reels.thought: When someone throws an ugly word, you don't have to throw one back. Bless them instead. That is how you inherit a blessing.
reels.verse: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
reels.think: Who can you bless instead of answer back?

reels.hook: The right word at the right time.
reels.thought: A word said at the right moment is like gold set in silver. Sometimes the kindest thing is waiting for the right time to say it.
reels.verse: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
reels.think: Who needs a well-timed word of hope from you?

reels.hook: The law of kindness on your tongue.
reels.thought: The woman of Proverbs 31 opened her mouth with wisdom, and kindness was the rule she spoke by. Let kindness be your rule too.
reels.verse: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
reels.think: What would change if kindness were the rule for everything you say?

reels.thought: In the King James Bible, charity means love that gives itself away. It is God's own kind of love put into action. It is bigger than a donation. It is a heart that moves toward people.
reels.verse: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
reels.think: Where is God asking your love to move toward someone?

reels.thought: You can give everything away and still miss it. God looks at the heart behind the gift. Without love, it profits nothing.
reels.verse: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
reels.think: Is love behind what you give, or something else?

reels.thought: Charity is patient. It is kind. It isn't jealous or showy. It doesn't push its own way, doesn't snap, and doesn't keep thinking the worst. That is how you know it is real.
reels.verse: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
reels.think: Which of these does God want to grow in you?

reels.thought: Real charity doesn't need a camera. Give quietly, so even your left hand doesn't know. Your Father sees in secret, and He rewards openly.
reels.verse: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
reels.think: What can you give this week that nobody will ever know about?

reels.thought: Don't give because you feel forced or guilty. Decide in your heart, then give with joy. God loves it when we give gladly.
reels.verse: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
reels.think: What would it look like to give with joy this week?

reels.hook: When you give to the poor, you lend to God.
reels.thought: Helping someone in need is never wasted. God takes it as a loan to Him, and He always pays back.
reels.verse: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
reels.think: Who in need can you show pity to this week?

reels.thought: Love isn't only something we say. It shows up. It brings the meal, makes the call, pays the bill, sits with the sick.
reels.verse: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
reels.think: What is one deed of love you can do today?

reels.thought: If someone is hungry and cold, telling them to be warm and full doesn't help. Charity meets the actual need in front of you.
reels.verse: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food, And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
reels.think: What real need around you can you meet?

reels.thought: Jesus said every meal, every visit, every coat given to the least person counts as done for Him. Charity is how we serve Jesus face to face.
reels.verse: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
reels.think: Who is the least of these that God has put near you?

reels.thought: A poor widow gave two small coins, all she had. Jesus said she gave more than all the rich. God measures what it cost you, not the size of the gift.
reels.verse: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
reels.think: What small gift could you give that would really cost you something?

reels.thought: A man was beaten and left on the road. The religious people passed by. A stranger stopped, cleaned his wounds and paid for his care. Jesus said, be like him.
reels.verse: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
reels.think: Who have you been walking past that you need to stop for?

reels.thought: If you can help and it is in your hand to do it, don't wait. Charity doesn't put off what it can do today.
reels.verse: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
reels.think: What good is in your hand to do right now?

reels.thought: Fervent charity doesn't go around exposing people's faults. It covers, forgives and keeps loving. That is how families and churches hold together.
reels.verse: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
reels.think: Whose faults can you cover with love instead of exposing?

reels.thought: Jesus said giving brings a deeper blessing than receiving. Support the weak, and you will find joy you can't buy.
reels.verse: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
reels.think: When did giving bless you more than getting?

reels.thought: Isaiah paints it plain: bread for the hungry, a home for the one put out, a coat for the cold, and never hiding from your own family when they need you.
reels.verse: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
reels.think: Which of these can you do this month?

reels.thought: Kindness, patience, forgiveness, giving. Charity is the belt that holds them all together. Put it on above everything else.
reels.verse: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
reels.think: What would your week look like if you put on charity first?

reels.thought: Before Paul names one piece of armor, he tells you where the strength comes from. Not your grit. His might. The armor only works on someone leaning on Him.
reels.verse: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
reels.think: Whose strength have you been running on this week?

reels.hook: Put it on. Don't just know it.
reels.thought: Paul didn't say study the armor. He said put it on. You can know every piece by heart and still walk out the door undressed.
reels.verse: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
reels.think: Which piece have you known about but never put on?

reels.thought: The coworker, the ex, the family member. They are not the real enemy. There is a spiritual battle behind what you see, and it takes spiritual armor.
reels.verse: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
reels.think: Who have you been fighting that you need to start praying for instead?

reels.thought: Some days winning looks like still standing when the evil day is over. You don't have to charge. You have to stay dressed and stay up.
reels.verse: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
reels.think: What would standing look like for you this week?

reels.thought: A soldier's belt held everything else in place. Truth does the same for you. When lies about who you are get loose, everything else starts slipping.
reels.verse: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
reels.think: What lie do you need to replace with truth today?

reels.thought: The belt isn't your opinion or your feelings. It's God's Word. When you don't know what's true, go back to what He said.
reels.verse: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
reels.think: Where do you need His Word to settle a question for you?

reels.thought: The breastplate covered the heart. Living right before God guards the center of you. Hidden sin is a crack in the plate, and the enemy aims right for it.
reels.verse: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
reels.think: What crack in your breastplate do you need to bring to God?

reels.thought: Isaiah saw the Lord Himself putting on righteousness as a breastplate and salvation as a helmet. You are not putting on soldier's gear. You are putting on what God wears.
reels.verse: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
reels.think: How does it change things to know this is God's own armor?

reels.thought: Roman soldiers wore shoes that gripped the ground so they wouldn't slide. The gospel of peace keeps your footing. You can stand on solid ground in a shaking season.
reels.verse: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
reels.think: Where do you feel like you're sliding right now?

reels.thought: The shoes aren't just for standing. They're for going. Peace with God makes you ready to carry peace to someone else.
reels.verse: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
reels.think: Who could use some good news from you this week?

reels.thought: Above all, Paul says, take the shield. The enemy throws fiery darts: fear, accusation, temptation, sudden bad news. Faith puts them out before they catch.
reels.verse: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
reels.think: What fiery dart has been hitting you lately?

reels.thought: Roman soldiers locked shields side by side and made a wall. Your faith is stronger standing next to other believers. Don't fight alone.
reels.verse: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
reels.think: Who can you lock shields with this week?

reels.thought: The battle starts in the mind. The helmet guards your thinking with what Jesus already did for you. You are saved. Think from there, not toward it.
reels.verse: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
reels.think: What thought do you need to measure against your salvation today?

reels.thought: Paul calls the helmet the hope of salvation. When your mind spins about tomorrow, hope in what God promised keeps your head covered.
reels.verse: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
reels.think: What worry about tomorrow needs to go under the helmet?

reels.hook: Piece 6: the sword of the Spirit.
reels.thought: Every other piece protects you. The sword is how you fight back. It is the Word of God, spoken out loud, at the right moment.
reels.verse: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
reels.think: What verse do you need ready for the battle you're in?

reels.thought: When Jesus was tempted in the wilderness, He didn't argue. He answered with Scripture, three times. That's the sword in action.
reels.verse: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
reels.think: What temptation needs an 'it is written' from you?

reels.thought: Prayer is how a dressed soldier stays in touch with the Commander. The armor isn't a one-time outfit. You stay in it by staying in prayer.
reels.verse: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
reels.think: Who will you cover in prayer while you're wearing your armor?

reels.thought: You can't out-argue, out-earn, or out-muscle a spiritual stronghold. God's weapons pull them down.
reels.verse: For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;
reels.think: What stronghold do you need God's weapons for?

reels.thought: You wouldn't walk out without clothes. Put on the armor the same way, daily, on purpose, before the day starts happening to you.
reels.verse: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
reels.think: Will you name each piece out loud tomorrow morning?

reels.thought: Every piece points to Him: He is the truth, our righteousness, our peace, the author of our faith, our salvation, the Word made flesh. Put Him on.
reels.verse: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
reels.think: What part of your life still needs to be covered by Him?

reels.thought: Armor isn't for running. Submit to God first, then stand your ground. The devil has to leave a believer who is dressed and submitted.
reels.verse: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
reels.think: What do you need to submit to God before you can resist?

reels.thought: God knew you before your body was ever made. There is a you on the inside, your spirit, that was carrying purpose before you were born.
reels.verse: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
reels.think: What purpose has God been whispering to your spirit?

reels.thought: God made you spirit, soul and body. Your spirit is the candle He uses to search and light you up inside. Feed it, or it grows dim.
reels.verse: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
reels.think: How have you been feeding your spirit lately?

reels.thought: You take care of your body and your mind. Don't forget your spirit. God wants the whole you kept and strong.
reels.verse: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
reels.think: Which part of you has been getting the least attention?

reels.thought: Your human spirit and the Holy Spirit are not the same, but they talk. His Spirit tells yours who you are: a child of God.
reels.verse: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
reels.think: What is the Holy Spirit telling your spirit right now?

reels.thought: While the church in Antioch worshipped and fasted, the Holy Ghost gave clear direction. When you get quiet before God, He can still tell you where to go.
reels.verse: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
reels.think: When will you get quiet enough to hear Him this week?
